description: Put-away detail marks a part group Done before the operator has scanned all pieces: the card's Done chip / dimming / scan-button removal follow the backend remainingQty (received − picked − put_away − allocated − staged), which nets out qty allocated to picking orders. When all (or part) of a received item is allocated to picking, remainingQty hits ≤ 0 with zero scans, so the card reads 已完成 with Scanned: 0 and the scan buttons disappear even though nothing was scanned
reproSteps: Receive an order, allocate an item's stock to a picking order, open the put-away detail for that order → the affected part card shows the green Done chip and no scan buttons while the operator has scanned nothing
remarks: Backfill — commit ccd9136d: Done display is now putAwayQty + stagedQty vs receivedQty − pickedQty (putAwayGroupComplete in apps/pda/utils/putAwayGroups.ts, used by components/put-away/PutAwayLotsPanel.vue) and deliberately ignores allocations; not-done groups with allocated qty carry a warning chip 已分配揀貨 {qty} 件 (i18n putAway.lotsPanel.allocatedChip). Backend remaining guard unchanged — scanning the allocated portion still 409s scanned_qty_exceeds_remaining until the allocation is released. CN put-away unaffected (allocatedQty always 0). Display-only; KMB compact-qty rounding precision fixed separately in 5b377eda
